newsitem.title: USA: Coke shares surge after sales report.
newsitem.headline: Coke shares surge after sales report.

text.p: Shares in Coca-Cola Co surged more than five percent on Thursday after the beverage giant reported expectations for a 10 percent rise in worldwide fourth-quarter unit case volumes and an 11-12 percent gain in gallon sales.
Industry analysts were in a meeting with Coke President M. Douglas Ivester and Chief Financial Officer James Chestnut, and could not be reached for comment immediately.
The anticipated sales gain exceeded some expectations on Wall Street, where analysts had forecast improvements of as little as five percent.
Near the close of trading, Coca-Cola shares were up 2-3/4 or 5.7 percent at 51-1/8. At that level, the price was within three points of its 52-week high of 53-7/8.
